description_en: Associates or dissociates a Cloud Desktop cluster with an Active Directory (AD) domain by calling SetClusterADDomain
description_zh: 调用SetClusterADDomain关联云桌面集群和AD域
kebab_example: aliyun gws set-cluster-ad-domain --cluster-id gws-rhzlyl5zx3ua0000 --domain-dns-ip 192.168.XX.XX --domain-name example.com --domain-password password000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetClusterADDomain

parameters.help_en: The DNS IP address of the AD domain
parameters.name: domain_dns_ip

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the AD domain
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The administrator password of the AD domain
parameters.name: domain_password

parameters.help_en: The administrator password of the AD domain
parameters.name: domain_admin

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to associate the cluster with the AD domain. Valid values:

false: Associates the cluster with the AD domain.
true: Dissociates the cluster from the AD domain.

Default value: false.

Before you associate the cluster with the AD domain, make sure that the network between the AD domain and the Cloud Desktop VPC is connected by using Smart Access Gateway, Express Connect, or other methods
parameters.help_zh:
是否建立集群和AD域的关联。取值范围：
false：建立集群与AD域的关联。
true：取消集群与AD域的关联。
默认为false。

建立集群域AD域的关联前，需要先通过智能接入网关、专线等方式打通AD域与云桌面VPC之间的网络
